title: Viwakilishi (Theme 2: Matumizi yafaayo ya dawa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses question pronouns (nani, nini, -pi, -ngapi) and pronouns of quality and self (-enyewe, -ote, -o -ote) with the class of the noun they stand for.
steps: Find what the pronoun stands for.
contexts: proper use of medicine: "Ni ipi ya kunywa?"

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Ipi imekwisha?" and "Dawa yenyewe imekwisha".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kiwakilishi kipi kinauliza kuhusu mtu?" Kwa nini "yeye" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni kiwakilishi kipi kinauliza kuhusu kitu?" Kwa nini "nani" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Katika "Mrefu amefika", mrefu ni nini?" Kwa nini "kivumishi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mrefu hapa linasimama badala ya nomino.
Kiwakilishi cha pekee hupatana na ngeli: kitabu chenyewe.
